overall_quality.evidence: Transformers and RNNs both process sequences, but they do so in fundamentally different ways. RNNs process sequences in a sequential manner, one element at a time, which can be slow and inefficient for long sequences. Transformers, on the other hand, use self-attention mechanisms to process all elements of a sequence simultaneously, making them much faster and more efficient for long sequences.
